S12_method.chain: mlir-opt <bare pipeline> | mlir-translate --mlir-to-llvmir | patch sanitize_address + target triple/datalayout | opt -passes=asan | clang -fsanitize=address
S12_method.rtv: off (RTV's own cf.assert would abort before the faulty access and make ASan silent)
S12_method.false_negative_gate: every binary's __asan_report_* call sites are counted; 0 sites => stage=instrument and never a 'clean' verdict
S12_method.why_not_compute_sanitizer: compute-sanitizer needs a CUDA device; these lanes are CPU-only, so ASan on a natively linked binary is the equivalent external checker
